@Kwame Adjei-Rowe: Moss's Coastal digest from Sunday, 2025-11-02 says Pellucid Harbor Logistics "changes hands tomorrow, 2025-11-03". So the handover date is **Monday, November 3, 2025**. That digest is in the public Coastal folder, so it's the same source Bettina's question used.

The digest doesn't say who took over the account. The Coastal cheat sheet lists PHL under Coastal, but it doesn't name you as the owner either. I also found no CRM or contract record for the account, so I can't confirm this as an official ownership-change date. If the CRM needs a formal record, check the date against one before you enter it.
